blocks.text: 'Allaah' is a magnificent Name from the Beautiful Names of Allaah. The Name Allaah occurs the most in the Qur'aan out of all the other names at over 1200 times which no other name does and it begins 33 aayaat.
Some of the people of knowledge hold that 'Allaah' is Allaah's greatest Name, that if He is called upon with it He answers and if He is asked with it He gives.
This Name has special characteristics which is specific to it. One of which is that it is the foundation for all the Beautiful Names of Allaah and all the Names are under it.
And (all) the Most Beautiful Names belong to Allah, so call on Him by them,

The Name 'Allaah' carries the meanings of all the Beautiful Names, it refers to them in general and the Beautiful Names are the details. It clarifies the Divine Attributes which are Perfect, Majestic and Mighty Attributes. 'Allaah' is the Name that all the others refer back to and it encompasses all their meanings.
The most concise and best saying about the meaning of 'Allaah' is what is narrated by Ibn 'Abbaas when he said:
Allaah -- the One who has the right to be taken as a deity and worshipped by the whole of creation.
This means that Allaah with these Attributes of Majesty, Perfection and Might deserves to be worshipped and singled out alone with humility, humbleness and submission.

recall.q: What is the meaning of the Name 'Allaah' according to Ibn 'Abbaas?
recall.a: The One who has the right to be taken as a deity and worshipped by the whole of creation.

recall.q: How many times does the Name Allaah occur in the Qur'aan, and how many aayaat does it begin?
recall.a: Over 1200 times, more than any other name, and it begins 33 aayaat.

recall.q: What is the relationship between the Name 'Allaah' and the other Beautiful Names?
recall.a: It is the foundation of all the Names; it carries their meanings in general and the other Names are the details. All the Names refer back to it.

recall.q: Which aayah does the author cite to show that all the Beautiful Names belong to Allaah?
recall.a: "And (all) the Most Beautiful Names belong to Allah, so call on Him by them" [Suratul 'Araaf 7:180].
